parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object|##.Schedule.{i}.Action}} object. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The current operational state of the {{object}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The order of the scheduled action.

parameters.name: Task
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|##.Task}} object used in this scheduled action}}

parameters.name: OutputDestination
parameters.description: {{list}} {{reference|a {{object|##.Schedule}} object used to receive the output(s) of this scheduled action}}

parameters.name: SuppressionTags
parameters.description: {{list|representing the suppression tags to be matched}}

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: {{list|each entry represents tags that are to be reported together with the measurement results.}}

parameters.name: Storage
parameters.description: The amount of secondary storage, in {{units}}, allocated to an instance of this {{object}}. The value of this parameter reflects the amount of allocated physical storage and not the storage used by logical data records. For example the secondary storage can be the storage allocated in a file system holding temporary data.

parameters.name: LastInvocation
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, in UTC that the {{object}} was invoked by the measurement agent.

parameters.name: LastSuccessfulCompletion
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, in UTC of a successful completion of the {{object}}.

parameters.name: LastSuccessfulStatusCode
parameters.description: The status code returned by successful execution of the {{object}}. A value of 0 indicates successful completion.

parameters.name: LastSuccessfulMessage
parameters.description: The message associated with the successful completion of the {{object}}.

parameters.name: LastFailedCompletion
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, in UTC of a failure to complete the {{object}}.

parameters.name: LastFailedStatusCode
parameters.description: The status code returned by failed execution of the {{object}}. A value of 0 indicates successful completion.

parameters.name: LastFailedMessage
parameters.description: The message associated with the failure to complete the task.

object.description: This object represents an action that is associated with the this {{object|##.Schedule}} object.
